accent.$doc: Theme-able accent layer. Components NEVER use brand-* or gold-* directly for themed parts; they use these CSS custom properties. A theme preset (themes.*) or a per-product palette (paletteDerivation) overrides them on a container: <section data-theme="premium-gold"> or style="--accent-...". Everything not listed here is INVARIANT (ink, ink-muted, surface, line, member-price badge, focus ring, danger).

--accent-decor.role: Decorative brand tone: motifs, icon fills, active indicator bars, stripe band 1. No text.
--accent-decor.contrastRule: none (decorative). If it is the ONLY indicator of state: >=3:1 vs its background.

--accent-decor-2.role: Second decorative tone (stripe band 3, secondary motifs). No text.

--accent-decor-3.role: Third decorative tone (stripe band 2, leaf cluster). No text.

--accent.role: Filled themed element (secondary themed button, active tab pill, selected chip fill).

--accent-text.role: Themed small text: eyebrows, links inside themed zones.

--accent-soft.role: Tinted background: card media backdrop, themed section bg, hover tint.
--accent-soft.contrastRule: ink >= 4.5:1 on it (always true for tints <= 12% mix)

--surface-themed.role: Section ground inside a themed container.

--accent-gradient.role: Optional ornament/hairline gradient (premium). Never behind text unless every stop passes the text rule.

member-price-badge.why: K-036: 'yeşil rozette üye fiyatı' — recognition must not change per theme. On dark/premium grounds add a 1px border: gold-300 (premium) or green-200.

price-text.why: Prices always sit on a light surface (white / accent-soft / gold-50), never on deep or gradient grounds.

primary-button.why: The single main CTA (Sepete ekle / Üye ol) keeps one learned color site-wide; hover-recolor never touches it (K-066 guard). Premium theme may swap to gold-500 + ink-deep ONLY on premium pages, never inside a hover-recolor.

onDark.use: Only exception: primary button on the single deep panel (--accent-deep). Alternative for preview: brand-lime bg + ink fg (5.19).

premium-gold.label: Premium / altın (yalnız ürüne/koleksiyona özel sayfa ve kartlar — K-065)

gold-foil.use: Hairlines, ornament strokes, stripe bands, monogram frames. NEVER behind text (#8A6A1F stop fails with ink-deep).

gold-button.use: Premium button fill; ink-deep text passes on every stop (11.13 -> 7.08).

forest-depth.use: Premium hero/section ground; white >= 10:1, gold-300 >= 8:1 on all stops.

gold-glow.use: Behind premium packshots on light or deep ground (decorative).

paletteDerivation.$doc: How a per-product/per-collection `palette { primary, secondary, tertiary, onPrimary }` (data/schema.ts v2, nullable; themeHint gold|premium -> themes.premium-gold if enabled in config) maps onto accent vars with GUARANTEED >= 4.5:1 text contrast. Computed at build time (data pipeline or src/lib/theme), never at runtime in the browser. Target ratio 4.6 (0.1 safety margin for rounding). Unit-tested; if any check fails the palette is dropped and the brand theme is used.

input.primary: hex, required — the product's identity color (e.g. pack color)
input.onPrimary: hex, optional — preferred text color on primary

steps: --accent-soft = primary mixed 10% into white (i.e. 90% white). Check ink >= 4.6 (always passes in practice: 10.4–11.4).

--accent / --on-accent: if onPrimary given and contrast(primary,onPrimary) >= 4.6 -> use them; else if contrast(primary,#FFFFFF) >= 4.6 -> on=#FFFFFF; else if relative luminance(primary) > 0.30 and contrast(primary,#333533) >= 4.6 -> on=#333533; else darken primary toward #1A1D1B in 2% steps (OKLCH lightness preferred, sRGB mix acceptable) until contrast with #FFFFFF >= 4.6, on=#FFFFFF
--accent-hover = --accent darkened 12% toward #1A1D1B (re-check on-accent >= 4.6; if on-accent is ink, lighten 10% toward white instead)
--accent-text = primary darkened toward #1A1D1B until contrast >= 4.6 vs BOTH #FFFFFF and --accent-soft
--accent-deep = primary darkened until contrast(#FFFFFF) >= 10; --on-accent-deep = #FFFFFF; --accent-on-deep = primary mixed 60% with white, checked >= 4.6 vs --accent-deep, else #FFFFFF
Output object stored with the product: palette.resolved { ...vars, checks{} }

font.brandbook: FuturaBookC (body), FuturaDemiC (headings), Comfortaa Bold (secondary; logo). Futura is commercial -> closest free web equivalent: Jost.

poppins.note: Previous working assumption; not in brandbook.

comfortaa.note: Jost body + Comfortaa (brandbook secondary) for display headings/eyebrows. Never body, prices, buttons, forms.

font.fallback: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

accent.use: Comfortaa 700: eyebrows (>= 15px), brand quote, big numerals, footer tagline. Max ~1 usage cluster per section.

jost-light-tracked.why: No extra font; stays inside Futura family; luxury via spacing + gold.

cormorant.style: Cormorant Garamond 500-600, >= 32px only, latin-ext (ğ ş ı İ supported)
cormorant.why: Research: all 5 premium references use a serif display (OZET #31). Only on premium-gold pages/cards, never body (low x-height -> 40+ legibility risk below 32px).

premiumDisplay.decision: User picks on preview (K-042 spirit). Cormorant loads only on premium routes (preload: false).

xs.use: 12px. Badge labels, PV chip, overline/eyebrow (uppercase, medium 500+). Single line only. Ink-muted 6.30 / green-700 5.35 -> AA.

sm.use: 14px. Meta, card brand/volume, helper text, breadcrumbs, footer links.

base.use: 16px body (K-177). Buttons, inputs (16px prevents iOS zoom), card title on mobile.

lg.use: 18px. Lead paragraphs, card title on desktop, card price amount.

xl.use: 20px. Drawer totals, H4, large card titles.

display.use: 44->92px. Hero H1 / editorial statements only. Weight 500-600.

mega.use: 56->136px. Decorative numerals/words (PV number, 404). aria-hidden or duplicated in accessible text.

ultra.use: 56->136px. HOME hero H1 only (K-233/K-234). Jost 700, max 3 lines, <=10 chars/line. cream-200 on forest-hero >= 4.73 (large text).

colossal.use: 96->288px. HOME decorative words/numerals only (hero 'DOĞA', showcase count, PV tile). Always aria-hidden; outline (typeStroke) or <=25% alpha; never carries meaning.

tight.use: Headings >= 22px not covered by fontSize letterSpacing.

section.use: 48->96px. Vertical rhythm between sections (K-177: tighter, editorial).

section-tight.use: 32->56px. Bands (finder band, PV band), stacked related sections.

wide.use: Hero, mega menu panel, full-bleed rails (1440px).

prose.use: Max line length for paragraphs (~72ch at 16px).

breakpoint.$doc: Tailwind v4 defaults kept; 360 is the design minimum (K-034).

tap.use: Preferred hit area = WCAG 2.5.8 comfort target (K-034, K-177).

control-sm.use: Chips, compact controls (hit area padded to 44 with ::before / padding).

control-lg.use: Hero CTA, drawer CTAs, mobile full-width CTAs.

header-compact.use: Desktop header after scroll; mobile header.

header-subnav.use: Desktop secondary link row (hidden when compact).

md.use: Inputs, small cards, mega menu tiles.

xl.use: Large panels (membership), hero art, drawer inner panels.

2xl.use: Signature leaf-cut corner (one corner only) on hero/feature media.

tile.use: K-188 big rounded tiles (teaser, category, feature) — 28px. radius.xl (2rem) stays for large panels.

panel.use: K-188 leaf-segment panel, hero frame, footer top corners — 36px.

tile.use: K-188 tiles on forest grounds: soft long drop.

long.use: Directional long shadow (light from top-left): icon badges, hero frames, panels.

cta-cream.use: Cream pill CTA on forest grounds.

card-on-forest.use: White product cards placed on forest grounds.

sticker.use: Packshot podium 'stickers' and rotated photo chips in home collages (light from top-left).

icon.set: Lucide (ISC) for UI glyphs; custom category set (12 roots) drawn on the same grid.
icon.categoryStyle: Line icon in ink + a soft leaf-shaped blob behind in --accent-soft/--accent-decor-3 at 35% (duotone). No emoji, no filled glyph sets.

fast.use: Hover color, focus — DEPRECATED alias, prefer xs/sm/md/lg/xl (K-156)

base.use: Button/card hover lift — DEPRECATED alias, prefer xs/sm/md/lg/xl (K-156)

slow.use: Reveal on scroll — DEPRECATED alias, prefer xs/sm/md/lg/xl (K-156)

slower.use: Hero entrance — DEPRECATED alias, prefer xs/sm/md/lg/xl (K-156)

ambient.use: DEPRECATED (K-158: ambient <= 5s, plays once). Kept so existing code does not break; do not use.

motion.rules: Source: docs/tasarim/hareket.md (owner hareket-tasarimcisi, K-155..K-159). Owner of timing/choreography: hareket-tasarimcisi (docs/tasarim/hareket.md). These are v0 seeds. Animate transform/opacity (+ registered color custom properties for hover-recolor). Everything decorative disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

z.$note: Builder currently ignores z; keep in sync with code.

stripe.use: Brand signature: horizontal bands (brandbook cover & letterhead). Order top->bottom: band 1, 2, 3 = --stripe-1/2/3 (default green, lime, blue).

signature.use: Hero bottom edge, membership panel bottom, footer very bottom.

thin.use: Header top edge (total 4px), drawer top edge, mega menu bottom edge.

giant.text: forest-950 #0A2A18 uppercase Jost 700 at ~72% of band height: on brand-green 5.48, brand-lime 6.49, brand-blue 5.68
giant.use: HOME 'Dev şerit' only (K-235). Replaces the signature band on that screen; never both.

gradient.$doc: K-186/K-188 showcase gradients. Every stop is checked for the text on it. NOT yet emitted by scripts/tokens/build-tokens.mjs (hand-off to frontend-mimar: emit as --gradient-<key> in :root like the premium gradients). Until then use the literal value.

forest-hero.text: white >= 6.21, cream-100 >= 5.38, cream-200 display >= 4.73 (large only on the #226E45 corner)
forest-hero.use: Hero slides, PV / üye ol / bulucu / blog page heroes.

tile-green.use: Green tile (reference light-green tile mapped to accessible green-700/800).

tile-cream.use: Light tile; the only tile that may carry prices (light surface).

cta-cream.use: Cream pill CTA on forest grounds (replaces primary-button.onDark there).

texture.$doc: K-186 felt/paper textures, delivered as SVG components (src/components/illustrations/textures.tsx) so they stay token-coloured. Rules: tasarim-kurallari §9.6. Max 1 texture + 1 pattern per screen.

grain.use: Felt/paper grain on forest grounds, tiles, footer. Static feTurbulence.

leaf-vein-emboss.use: Embossed leaf veins on forest section grounds.

paper-cut.use: Layered leaves with drop-shadow filter (dx 6, dy 10, blur 8, forest-950 @ 35%).

surfaceMode.$doc: K-186: two surface modes decide grounds per area. Prices always sit on a light surface (invariant).

showcase.where: Home hero swiper, home teaser tiles + leaf panel, PV / üye ol / bulucu / blog / haberler page heroes, footer, mega menu promo tile, coming-soon pages.

commerce.where: Listing grids, PDP buy box, drawer, search, forms. Product cards are always white.

typeStroke.$doc: Outline decorative type (-webkit-text-stroke + transparent fill). Decorative only, never real text.

outline-on-light.use: green-700 @22% on white/cream (showcase count). Follows --accent-decor inside RecolorZone.

colorBlock.$doc: K-236: brand colours as flat section/collage grounds, HOME only. Text on them is forest-950 only.

collage.$doc: K-237 home collage grammar. Back->front layer order and limits; tasarim-kurallari §15.
collage.gapToText: 32px min between real text column and any collage layer (except decorative type)

heroIntro.$doc: K-233 budget (ui-tasarimci). Exact easing/keyframes owned by hareket-tasarimcisi (hareket.md). CSS-only, fill-mode both, no JS gate.
heroIntro.reducedMotion: logo + H1 opacity only (soft), no translate/rotate (K-231)
heroIntro.lcpFallback: if mobile LCP > 2.5s: logo 600ms, H1 fade starts at 300ms
heroIntro.replay: on full load of / only; not on in-session client navigation back to / (S-067b)
